episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Ex-con photographer R.J. Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

episodes.title: Twenty Pounds of Clem in a Ten-Pound Bag
episodes.summary: Wish enlists R.J.'s help on a bizarre case when his late cellmate's son is wrongly accused of murder.

episodes.title: The Needle and the Damage Done
episodes.summary: R.J. is recruited by Emi to investigate the disappearance of a wealthy rehab tycoon's son. Mel and Catherine discover they have different views on parenting and finances.

episodes.title: In Vanity Veritas
episodes.summary: R.J. finds himself at the center of a suburban housewife murder mystery. Catherine worries that R.J. is getting too close to Emi.

episodes.title: Burn Notice
episodes.summary: R.J. unravels the truth about a Little League coach whose family is being mysteriously targeted. Meanwhile, R.J.'s parole officer worries that he is pushing the boundaries of his conditional release.

episodes.title: Brenner's Back
episodes.summary: R.J. helps a young woman uncover the truth behind her boyfriend's sudden death. Meanwhile, a dangerous figure from R.J.'s past resurfaces, bent on revenge.

episodes.title: You've Got Bale
episodes.summary: R.J. takes on a strange case following a grocery store robbery gone wrong. Meanwhile, Emi's loyalty is tested when her father's misdeeds come to light.

episodes.title: Burn the Boats
episodes.summary: R.J. struggles with a difficult decision, while Emi must contend with her family's secrets.

episodes.title: Even Walls Fall Down
episodes.summary: After R.J. learns the truth about what happened on the fateful day Lucas stole his camera, he enlists his inner circle to help him take down Victor Ochoa.

episodes.title: The Point of Us Breaking
episodes.summary: A reunion with an old prison acquaintance pulls R.J. into a string of daring bank heists as the fallout from Victor Ochoa's death deepens.

episodes.title: Manos: Hands of Fate
episodes.summary: A missing man, a mysterious item and a dangerous stranger in a pickup truck pull R.J. into one of his strangest cases yet. Meanwhile, someone close to him is caught up in a mystery all their own.
